content.text: Only 1 "mismatch" out of 150 — and it's just the explicitly-allowed witness choice difference (both pairs are valid distinct class paths). Let me refine the fuzzer to handle witness freedom properly and run a much bigger campaign:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('fuzz.py').read()
old = '''def norm_witnesses(out):
    o = json.loads(json.dumps(out))
    for c in o["classes"]:
        w = c["candidate_witnesses"]
        c["candidate_witnesses"] = [list(x) for x in sorted(tuple(map(tuple, w)))]
    return o
'''
new = '''def strip_witnesses(out):
    o = json.loads(json.dumps(out))
    for c in o["classes"]:
        c["candidate_witnesses"] = None
    return o

def witnesses_valid(out, doc):
    edges = doc["edges"]; n = doc["n"]
    for c in out["classes"]:
        w = c["candidate_witnesses"]
        if len(w) not in (1, 2):
            return False
        if len(w) == 1 and c["candidate_count"] != 1:
            return False
        if len(w) == 2 and c["candidate_count"] < 2:
            return False
        for path in w:
            node = 0
            for eid in path:
                if not (0 <= eid < len(edges)) or edges[eid]["u"] != node:
                    return False
                node = edges[eid]["v"]
                if tuple(edges[e]["label"] for e in path) != tuple(c["signature"]):
                    return False
            if node != n - 1:
                return False
        if len({tuple(p) for p in w}) != len(w):
            return False
    return True
'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
old2 = '''        errs = check(doc, a)
        if errs:
            print("INVARIANT VIOLATION", i, errs); print(json.dumps(doc)); bad += 1
        if norm_witnesses(a) != norm_witnesses(b):'''
new2 = '''        errs = check(doc, a)
        if errs:
            print("INVARIANT VIOLATION", i, errs); print(json.dumps(doc)); bad += 1; continue
        if not witnesses_valid(a, doc) or not witnesses_valid(b, doc):
            print("BAD WITNESS", i); print(json.dumps(doc)); bad += 1; continue
        if strip_witnesses(a) != strip_witnesses(b):'''
assert old2 in src
src = src.replace(old2, new2)
src = src.replace('            print("MISMATCH", i)', '            print("MISMATCH", i)')
open('fuzz.py','w').write(src)
import ast; ast.parse(src); print("ok")
EOF
python3 fuzz.py 1 200 2>&1 | tail -3
